name: Rich Universe Network Limited
about: Rich Universe Network Limited engages in the provision of financial services to corporates in India. It provides assistance for business set-up and planning, recognition of associates, market intelligence for trade, and legal advisory services, as well as acquisition, merger, and internal corporate restructuring. It also offers intelligence services and monitors the broader market for identifying competitors and tracking their activities. The company was formerly known as Rich Capital & Financial Services Ltd and changed its name to Rich Universe Network Limited in May 2011. Rich Universe Network Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Kanpur, India.
